study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dissecting task-based fMRI activity using normative modelling: an application to the Emotional Face Matching Task

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Unknown corresponds to Amsterdam Open MRI Collection Population Imaging of Psychology (AOMIC PIOP2) and Duke Neurogenetics Study (DNS), which are not listed in the provided dataset table.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Due to its experimental simplicity and focus on subcortical circuitry relevant to brain disorders, the EFMT has been implemented in a number of large-scale neuroimaging initiatives including the UK Biobank ... the Human Connectome Project (HCP) ... HCP Development ... the Amsterdam Open MRI Collection Population Imaging of Psychology (AOMIC PIOP2) ... and the Duke Neurogenetics Study (DNS). ... We then apply these models to over 200 participants ... from the MIND-Set cohort"

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Reference datasets are combined to build the reference normative models; MIND-Set patients are the clinical cohort for application, and MIND-Set controls are included in reference train/test splits (C in Supplementary Figure 1).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "We take advantage of these large open-access/shared datasets to collate a large representative sample of over 7500 participants from six sites to ... build reference normative models... We then apply these models to over 200 participants ... from the MIND-Set cohort"; "Supplementary Figure 1 : Age and sex distributions and sample splits... Details of the number of participants into the Reference model training and test split, and the clinical test application... C = unaffected MIND-Set control. P = MIND-Set patient."
